## Final Accepted Amendments

### `fr-4-7dfb6287`

The `check_strictly_increasing` helper in crates/tank_core/src/invariants.rs:398-409 only reports the upper field name and value in its error. When the invariant fires (e.g., `optimal_temp_min_c >= optimal_temp_max_c`), the error says `InvariantViolation { field: "shrimp_params.optimal_temp_max_c", value: X }` without mentioning the lower bound that caused the conflict. Consider including both field names or a more descriptive message to aid debugging.
